about: The methadone tablets for longstanding osteoarthritis pain cover 13 January to 9 March 2026 during carbamazepine treatment for recorded epilepsy.

possible finding: the record holds no line about epilepsy. Dilantin (phenytoin) is supplied every 30 days from 2 February 2026 and Endone (oxycodone) on 12 March and 9 April 2026, both by brand name only, while the phenytoin supplies of 4 March and 3 April are running.
Carbamazepine (Teril) is supplied with tramadol for a person with trigeminal neuralgia. Specialist review explicitly excluded epilepsy at L002.
